subject: Apollo crewed lunar-landing proposition and post-1972 replication gap
purpose: Stress-test OGI v0.3 on adjudicating a contested historical-technological proposition before explaining its downstream anomaly
originating_observation: Humans often imitate and escalate difficult demonstrated achievements, yet no human has landed on the Moon since 1972.
governing_questions: Did humans land on the Moon as claimed?
What does each evidence class actually establish?
Which evidence streams are institutionally independent?
Can alternative staged models explain the joint evidence field without unsupported bridges?
If crewed landings are sufficiently warranted, what explains the post-1972 replication gap?

first_pass_failure.summary: The first pass explained the lunar-return gap using program shutdown and political-field variables before adjudicating the antecedent crewed-landing proposition.

triggers: Apollo 11 footpad geometry and descent sequence
material_updates: Nixon full-call propagation analysis corrected: 2.56 s is lunar radio round-trip only, not complete White House call path
Independent Chandrayaan-2 Apollo 11 OHRC image upgraded from NOT_RETRIEVED to LOCATED/PUBLISHED
Specific rover-track morphology remains NOT_ADJUDICATED because the alleged image is not present in the current attachments

prohibited_shortcuts: NASA evidence streams are all counted as institutionally independent
Physical equipment on the Moon automatically proves human emplacement
A non-falsifiable alternative receives equal warrant merely because it cannot be logically excluded
The post-1972 gap is explained before Apollo itself is adjudicated

subject_finding.summary: Several popular technical anomalies inspected in this case have direct engineering explanations. Independent tracking, laser ranging, surface hardware/experiments, returned lunar samples, orbital site consistency and non-US observations form a convergent evidence field. Reopen 1 strengthened the non-US image leg by locating a peer-reviewed Chandrayaan-2 OHRC Apollo 11 site image, while correcting the prior Nixon-call propagation floor. No single inspected item is a self-sufficient proof of people on the surface. The crewed-landing model currently requires substantially fewer unsupported auxiliary assumptions than staged alternatives. The post-1972 crewed-surface gap remains a separate legitimate anomaly.
